name: White-breasted Nuthatch
desc: White-breasted Nuthatch (Sitta carolinensis): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 105 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The white-breasted nuthatch is a species of bird in the nuthatch family Sittidae. It is a medium-sized nuthatch, measuring approximately 15.5 cm (6.1 in) in length.
